unclear: Return an interval with no point score or provisional pass
independent_safety_and_revision: Record evidence and review flags; no additional numeric deduction beyond criterion credit and the existing named critical-error rules
advance_gate: Complete all 32 valid judgments, detect each authored unsafe error, strictly order safe > partial > unsafe in all 8 case-language-judge groups, repeat all 8 partial criterion/error vectors and scores, and have no unresolved independent safety/revision concern on safe or partial controls. Passing permits only a separately specified small development candidate pilot.
limits: Author hypotheses only. Existing cases/anchors are unreviewed; no claim of clinical correctness or achieved score bands. Fixed stage weights prioritize the updated decision. This alternative changes the score definition and cannot be pooled with or overwrite historical scores.
comparison: Fresh S26 two-family full-scoring panel with S27 anchor boundary; historical runs remain separate.
